articles.title: Letter: Thanks to Everyone on Tannery Street
body: To the editor: I want to thank the people who showed up on the south end of Tannery Street after the flood. I came over on the first Saturday with a shovel and a borrowed pair of boots, and I was not the only one who didn’t know what I was doing. Ed and Marion Ostrowski fed everybody who came through their driveway, and the Foundry Street boys hauled more mud than anybody.

The relief fund at St. Brendan’s is still open. The flood took more than furniture. It took workshops, tools, and in some cases the only car a family owned. If you can spare a check, bring it to the hall on Thursday evenings through August. Every dollar goes to the homeowners on Tannerv Street and along the lower millrace.
Ruth Okafor, Tannery Flats
